in_marathi.long_meaning: Bhuvnesh हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। The name Bhuvnesh is derived from Sanskrit, where 'Bhuv' means 'Lord' and 'Nesh' means 'Creation'. It signifies the one who is the lord of creation and is revered in Hindu mythology.
